text:
carla: FYI planning a staggered preflight tonight 00:30-01:10 UTC. Sequence: api -> runtime -> console -> router. We want a small staged router reload (instance-by-instance) and a holdback window after runtime promotion. Call blockers now.

ben: API: sha-api-88 ready. No migrations. Canary smoke in eu-staging is green.

oscar: Runtime: promoting rt-4.0.0-quant (sha-rt-400q). Emits X-Runtime-Flag:quant which requires router whitelist. Router reload will be staggered to avoid mass 400 spikes.

lina: Console: tiny copy + telemetry mute. Will set FEATURE_BETA=false for canary and mute frontend telemetry.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled wave 00:35 UTC. Sequence: api=sha-api-88,runtime=sha-rt-400q,console=sha-ui-54,router=sha-router-21. Canary policy: eu-only 0.5% for 15m then 5% for 10m. Prewarm probe between api and runtime for 4m. Auto-rollback enabled per thread rules.

carla: New: we'll add a 10m "holdback" after runtime promotion to verify router instance-by-instance whitelist propagation before full router rollout. If holdback passes, we'll continue router reload in rolling fashion.

oscar: Runtime fallback plan: if router whitelist not present by end of holdback, runtime will be pinned to sha-rt-391c (compat mode) via deploybot pin.

ben: Ops request: scope initial canary to router-standby cluster and limit to eu-west cluster for the first 15m. Also prefer 0.5% traffic slice.

deploybot: deploybot: canary targets set: cluster=router-standby,region=eu-west,traffic=0.5%. Prewarm probe endpoint: /internal/prewarm will run for 4m.

sre-bot: Staging smoke results: 12/12 checks OK. p99 api=115ms, p99 runtime=190ms. Dashboards and alert links posted.

carla: Rollback triggers (condensed):
- immediate rollback if error rate >1% sustained for 3 minutes
- or p99 latency >2s sustained for 3 minutes
- or prewarm/healthcheck failures >3 in 5m
To trigger immediate rollback reply exactly "rollback" in this thread. deploybot will run the rollback sequence.

oscar: Note on router reload: each instance reload ~30-60s. We'll stagger by 20s between hosts to keep capacity. We'll run a header-accept probe after each instance reload.

lina: I'll mute frontend telemetry and watch user-facing metrics. Also posting release note to #release-notifications at start.

ben: I'll watch api traces and adjust canary slice if needed.

oscar: If we detect any 400 spikes from routers during runtime canary, plan = rollback runtime and abort router reload. If whitelist lagging, deploybot pin command ready:

```bash
# pin runtime to compat
deploybot pin --service=runtime --version=sha-rt-391c --wave=stagger-8923
```

shepherd: shepherd: preflight checklist OK. Will post start/finish events to #release-notifications.

carla: Everyone please ack if you can monitor at 00:30 UTC. If no ack by 00:15 UTC we postpone.

ben: Ack.

oscar: Ack, will tail router-21 and standby logs.

lina: Ack.

deploybot: deploybot: standing by to execute on approval. Will stream events and webhooks to SRE tools.

sre-bot: Alerts and SLO dashboards linked. Runbooks attached.

carla: Thanks 52 see you at kickoff. Will post start note and pin release metadata when we begin.
